summary: Mobilicom Ltd files a Form 6-K incorporating a press release about securing $2.2 million in new purchase orders for its SkyHopper PRO and ICE Cybersecurity suite from a Tier-1 drone manufacturer under a $249 million U.S. DoW Program of Record. The orders are a routine commercial contract update, not a change-of-control event. Deliveries have commenced and are expected to conclude within 2026. No board recommendation or advisors are named. No special-situation category applies; this is an ordinary business development filing.
